pages.text: 咘咘的小信号 / BUBU'S LITTLE SIGNAL
咘咘正在画一朵大花。小肚子轻轻告诉她：有一点想尿尿。咘咘想，再画一朵花，就一朵。她没有起来。
pages.text_en: Bubu was drawing a big flower. Her tummy whispered: I need to pee a little. Bubu thought, just one more flower. She did not get up.

pages.text: 过了一会儿，小信号变成了大信号。咘咘夹着腿跳来跳去：“妈妈，我要尿尿，现在就要！”两个人跑啊跑，刚刚好赶上，可是肚子胀得好难受。
pages.text_en: A little later, the little signal became a big signal. Bubu squeezed her legs and hopped: "Mommy, I need to pee right now!" They ran and ran and just made it — but her tummy felt so tight and sore.

pages.text: 妈妈拿出三个气球说：“小肚子像气球。气球小小的时候，不难受，还有很多时间，我们慢慢走过去。气球胀得满满的，就会很难受，还会啪地爆掉——尿尿也会来不及。”
pages.text_en: Mommy showed three balloons. "Your tummy is like a balloon. When the balloon is small, it feels fine, and we have plenty of time to walk slowly. When it is stuffed full, it feels awful, and it might pop — the pee might not wait, either."

pages.text: 妈妈说：“记住哦，有一点点感觉，就先去马桶上坐一下。尿不出来，也没关系。你的画、你的玩具，都会在这里等你。”咘咘跟着念了一遍。
pages.text_en: Mommy said, "Remember: at the very first little feeling, go and sit on the toilet for a while. If nothing comes, that's okay. Your drawing and your toys will wait right here for you." Bubu repeated it after her.

pages.text: 下午搭积木，塔只差最后一块，小信号又轻轻来了。咘咘看看塔，心里想：我走了，他们会不会先搭完？
pages.text_en: In the afternoon, the block tower needed just one more block when the little signal came again. Bubu looked at the tower and wondered: if I go, will they finish it without me?

pages.text: 咘咘想起气球的话，把积木放好：“等我一下，我去坐一下。”她坐在马桶上等了一小会儿，肩膀慢慢放松，尿出来啦。
pages.text_en: Bubu remembered the balloons. She put the block down: "Wait for me, I'll go and sit for a while." She sat on the toilet, her shoulders relaxed, and out came the pee.

pages.text: 咘咘洗好手回来，塔没有变，最后一块也还在。她亲手放上去，开心地说：“去坐一下，真的没有耽误！”
pages.text_en: Bubu washed her hands and came back. The tower had not changed, and the last block was still there. She placed it herself: "I went and sat, and I missed nothing!"

pages.text: 幼儿园里，小汤快做好了。咘咘又听到了小信号，她抱着小锅想：我走了，他们会不会先吃完？
pages.text_en: At kindergarten, the pretend soup was almost ready. Bubu heard the little signal again. Holding the pot, she wondered: if I go, will they eat without me?

pages.text: 咘咘小声告诉杨老师。老师说：“幼儿园是蹲坑，我们先去蹲一下。蹲不出来，也没关系。小汤等你。”
pages.text_en: Bubu told Teacher Yang quietly. The teacher said, "Our kindergarten toilet is a squat toilet. Go and squat for a little while. If nothing comes, that's okay. The soup will wait for you."

pages.text: 咘咘踩好两边的小脚印，稳稳蹲下来，等了一小会儿。这一次她一点也不着急，尿自己就出来了。
pages.text_en: Bubu put her feet on the two foot spots, squatted down steadily, and waited a little while. This time she was not in a hurry at all, and the pee came by itself.

pages.text: 咘咘回来啦！小汤还等着她，谁也没有先吃。她给大家一人盛一碗：“去蹲一下，大家真的会等我。”
pages.text_en: Bubu came back! The soup was still waiting, and nobody had eaten first. She served everyone a bowl: "I went and squatted for a while, and everyone really waited for me."

pages.text: 晚上，咘咘指着水滴、马桶和积木塔，自己讲给 NONO 听：“有一点，就去坐一下。东西会等我。”
pages.text_en: That night, Bubu pointed to the droplet, the toilet, and the tower, telling NONO the story herself: "A little signal means go and sit. My things will wait for me."

pages.text: 睡前，咘咘也去坐了一下。然后她安心地躺进被窝：今天的小信号，她都听见啦。
pages.text_en: Before bed, Bubu went and sat for a little while, too. Then she snuggled into bed: today, she had heard every little signal.

pages.text: 记住咘咘的小办法：有一点，就去坐一下。去一下，马上回来，东西会等我。
pages.text_en: Remember Bubu's little way: a little signal means go and sit for a while. Go, come right back — your things will wait for you.
